identity.title: [v0.92][runtime-v3][20.c] Run six-hour Agent Logic Spot qualification only after operator and cost authorization

values.task_boundary: Implement the fixed six-hour suite and issue-owned launch/proof wrapper, run one authorized Spot attempt, review exact evidence, publish, merge, finish, and clean up.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Exact base contains the merged #266, #267, #373, and #374 production qualification inputs.

AC-2: The suite fixes a minimum 21,600-second monotonic exposure, enforces a numeric 600-second timeout and cap on final-cycle overshoot, records measured elapsed and overshoot, and rejects caller duration weakening.
AC-3: Launch fails before mutation without exact Agent Logic identity, immutable revision/image, Spot-only posture, deadline, kill switch, and USD 20-or-lower ceiling.
AC-4: One attempt sustains at least 50 authenticated HTTPS and WSS connections and records every declared fault/recovery receipt without threshold weakening.
AC-5: Success, failure, interruption, timeout, and cancellation retain causal evidence and terminate only exact run-tag-owned resources.
AC-6: Independent post-cleanup readback proves zero task-owned instances and evidence is redacted and digest-bound.
AC-7: Focused contracts, strict Clippy, exact scope, paid receipt validation, exact-head review, hosted CI, finish/cache/ancestry all pass.
dependencies: Operator authorization: #268 only, USD 20 total ceiling
